clips.text: The introduction outlines the purpose of Soma Sound, offering immersive listening experiences to calm the nervous system for meditation, relaxation, and restorative sleep.

beschreibung:
Embody your inner healer with restorative sounds of nature and soothing somatic soundscapes. Allow your breath to bring you into a state of relaxed integration ~ light traveling to every limb, finger, muscle, joint – feeling your energetic body in branches of golden light, glowing meridians, radiant crown and grounding roots to the earth. Experience full body breathing – inhaling, receiving and exhaling slowly releasing anything that is no longer needed. Giving yourself this gift of space for mindful rest and renewing deep trust in your body’s innate healing wisdom.

Welcome to SOMA Sound ~ healing music and nature sounds to calm the nervous system for deep relaxation, meditation, and restorative sleep. Each immersive deep listening experience is offered as a gentle restorative practice to help you reconnect to your body’s natural state of healing, balance and resilience.
